description: This file defines a service named SoundAlarmListenerService that extends WearableListenerService to listen for data changes related to alarm activation. It manages media playback of an alarm sound at maximum volume when triggered and restores the original volume when deactivated.

classes.name: SoundAlarmListenerService
classes.description: A service that listens for data changes indicating whether to activate or deactivate an alarm sound, managing volume levels and media playback accordingly.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the AudioManager, retrieves the original and maximum alarm volumes, sets the default alarm sound URI, and creates a new MediaPlayer instance.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Restores the original alarm volume and releases media resources when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles data change events to start or stop the alarm sound based on the received alarm state. Sets the alarm to maximum volume when activated, and restores previous volume when deactivated.
